title: existing: adoption never creates the adopted table's declared indexes, checks, FKs or primary key

basis: D25; ruling J10 (adoption creates what hejbro manages); the owner's detect-and-name rule (no silent prevention); #694's analysis of fixes A and C; #671 and #668 measurements
